Name: Old Town Paving Stones
Author: euzcian
Description:
[b]* Important Notes / Known Issues[/b]

[b]* Safe Removal Required[/b]: If you have placed these floors in your world and saved the game, you must [b][i]replace[/i][/b] all mod floors with any vanilla floor and [b][i]save again[/i][/b] before removing this mod. Removing the mod directly will corrupt dependent save files.

[b]* Visual Glitch[/b]: Some tiles may exhibit texture errors when connecting (a known graphical rendering issue). An optional patch rug is provided in the ‘Optional Files’ section to cover and improve these areas. Please note this is not a perfect fix. For visual examples, please check the posts section.



A set of paths made to complement Gwen's Medieval buildings.


Requirements

SMAPI - Stardew Modding API
Content Patcher

Usage

Purchase the recipe from Robin.
Craft it at your Crafting Menu.


I've designed it with some complexity, and as a result, it might take some getting used to. 
But I hope you enjoy it! 

Please do not reupload this mod without permission.





[b]* 注意 / 已知问题[/b]

[b]* 关于安全卸载[/b]：如果您在游戏中铺设了本地板并进行了保存，后续若想移除本模组，必须先进入游戏，将所有本地板[b][i]替换[/i][/b]为任意原版地板，并[b][i]再次保存[/i][/b]，之后方可安全移除。直接移除模组将导致依赖存档损坏。
[b]
* 关于图形瑕疵[/b]：部分地砖在连接时可能出现贴图错误（已知的图形渲染问题）。在“可选文件”中提供了一个修补地毯，可以覆盖瑕疵区域以作改善（请注意，这并非完美修复）。具体效果请在帖子评论（posts）区查看。



为了搭配Gwen的中世纪建筑制作的一组小径


要求

SMAPI - Stardew Modding API
Content Patcher

用法

在罗宾处购买配方
在制作菜单中进行制作


我将它设计得有些复杂，因此可能需要一些时间来适应。
但我希望你能喜欢！

请不要在未经允许的情况下二次上传本模组。

Downloads.Description:
- Fixed missing item names.
- Added an option to enable/disable snow cover in winter (enabled by default). The setting can be changed in the mod config menu.

- 修复了物品名字缺失
- 添加了冬天是否启用积雪的选项，默认为启用，可在配置菜单中更改。

Downloads.Description:
An imperfect patch to fix some of the glitched tiles. You can find them in the Furniture Catalog under Rugs. You can toggle the winter snow cover in the Mod Config Menu.

一个不完美的补丁，用来修复部分错误瓷砖。可以在家具目录-地毯中找到它们。可以在配置菜单中选择是否启用积雪。
